audit.summary: The exact acquired arXiv2205.11453v1 was fully read and visually checked. A positive-probability finite-block construction disproves the scalar-kernel domination of a time-shifted random operator. Independent exact Galerkin differentiation disproves the transported-density formula under the paper's own covariance. These break essential local-estimate and density-bootstrap derivations. Density normalization has a consistent fixed-factor repair; a replacement phase-resolved operator proof is not certified. Six further groups give exact local corrections. Parameter elimination agrees with the printed threshold.
